brief.prompt: A woman stands in a bright living room in a relaxed side-on pose with her head level, while a smartphone mounted on a small tripod at head height faces her from a few steps away. Daylight from a large window falls evenly across her face, and the scene feels calm and practical.
brief.alt: Woman taking a level side-profile photo with a phone on a tripod to check her chin projection
brief.purpose: Demonstrates the controlled self-photo setup (rear camera at head height, level head, soft even light) from the self-check section.

review.alt: Woman in a cream sweater and jeans standing in side profile with her head level in a bright living room, facing a smartphone mounted on a tripod at head height, with soft daylight from a large window.
